paragraphs.text: 1. ARAYI, one-eyed limping hag, fly, ever-screeching, to the hill.
paragraphs.original: अरायि काणे विकटे गिरिं गच्छ सदान्वे ।
paragraphs.translit: arāyi kāṇe vikaṭe giriṃ gaccha sadānve |

paragraphs.text: We frighten thee away with these, the heroes of Sirimbitha.
2. Scared from this place and that is she, destroyer of each germ unborn.
Go, sharp-horned Brahmanaspti and drive Arayi far away.
3. Yon log that floats without a man to guide it on the river's edge,-
paragraphs.original: अदो यद्दारु प्लवते सिन्धोः पारे अपूरुषम् ।
paragraphs.translit: ado yaddāru plavate sindhoḥ pāre apūruṣam |

paragraphs.text: Seize it, thou thing with hideous jaws, and go thou far away thereon.
paragraphs.original: तदा रभस्व दुर्हणो तेन गच्छ परस्तरम्
paragraphs.translit: tadā rabhasva durhaṇo tena gaccha parastaram

paragraphs.text: 4. When, foul with secret stain and spot, ye hastened onward to the breast,
All Indra's enemies were slain and passed away like froth and foam.
5. These men have led about the cow, have duly carried Agni round,
And raised their glory to the Gods. Who will attack them with success?
paragraphs.original: देवेष्वक्रत श्रवः क इमाँ आ दधर्षति
paragraphs.translit: deveṣvakrata śravaḥ ka imām̐ ā dadharṣati
